gunsnprices 0.1.0, PHP title parser for firearms and ammunition.
Source: https://github.com/gunsnprices/gunsnprices-php (Composer: gunsnprices/gunsnprices)

Copied by tools/vendor-parser.php with one change: the namespace GunsNPrices\... became
GunsNPricesCpr\Vendor\GunsNPrices\... so this copy cannot clash with another extension that ships the same library.
